question: In which year was the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act was passed in the year **2019**.
 
• This act reorganized the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two separate Union Territories: Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh.
 
• The reorganization came into effect on **31st October 2019**.
